detailed_description:
The target video uses a realistic cinematic live-action style with warm fluorescent subway lighting, subtle film grain, and natural handheld camera motion that mimics a passenger's perspective inside a moving train.
[Shot 1] A medium two-shot establishes <Subject 1>, the subway car interior with shiny metallic poles, brown overhead hand straps, a colored route map above the sliding doors, warm fluorescent ceiling lights running the length of the car, and seated passengers in the soft-focus background. <Subject 2> (S1), the young woman with black hair in a high bun secured by a black clip, wearing an open blue-and-white vertical striped button-up shirt over a white cropped tank top, light blue jeans with a brown leather belt, and a beige canvas tote bag on her left shoulder, stands on the left gripping an overhead strap with her right hand. <Subject 3> (S2), the young woman with long straight dark brown hair and black sunglasses resting on top of her head, wearing a fitted grey short-sleeve t-shirt and blue jeans with a white leather crossbody bag with gold chain details, stands on the right holding the central metallic pole with both hands. They face each other with warm smiles. The camera uses a Static Shot with very subtle natural sway from the moving train. <Subject 2> (S1) leans slightly toward <Subject 3> and says in an excited, conversational young female voice with a Wuhan regional inflection and an eager upbeat pace, <d>[Chinese] 你听说了吗？武汉地铁上抖音团购了，<scenetrans></d> Her lips remain parted mid-sentence as the shot continues.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the camera cuts to a medium close-up of <Subject 2> (S1), the young woman with the black high bun and blue-and-white striped shirt from Shot 1. She still grips the overhead strap with her right hand, and the beige tote bag strap remains visible on her left shoulder. The subway car's warm fluorescent lights and a blurred route map fill the background behind her. The camera Pushes In with small amplitude at slow speed. <Subject 2> (S1) continues seamlessly across the cut, saying in the same excited young female voice with Wuhan inflection, <d><scenetrans>只要一分钱就可以抢五折卡，可以用三次哟！</d> She finishes the line with an enthusiastic smile and raises her eyebrows, then closes her mouth and nods slightly to emphasize the deal.
[Shot 3] At 00:09.000, the camera cuts to a medium close-up of <Subject 3> (S2), the young woman with long straight dark brown hair and black sunglasses on her head, wearing the grey short-sleeve t-shirt from Shot 1. Her white leather crossbody bag with gold chain details rests against her hip, and her hands still hold the central metallic pole. The warm subway interior and blurred seated passengers fill the background. The camera holds a Static Shot. <Subject 3> (S2)'s eyes widen with delighted surprise and she opens her mouth in a bright smile, saying in a cheerful young female voice with genuine excitement and a slightly higher pitch, <d>[Chinese] 真的吗？太棒了</d> She closes her mouth into a wide happy smile and gives a small excited bounce on her feet.

A continuous subway ambience runs throughout: the low rhythmic rumble of train wheels on tracks, the faint whine of electric motors, occasional metallic creaks of the car body, and muted background passenger murmur. The fluorescent lights emit a very faint electrical hum.
